raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`LTX2TwoStagePipeline` with `Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers` cannot start with default flags. sgl-project/sglang#45977 turns BCG on by default for this pipeline, and the BCG warmup resolution is seeded from the model's sampling default, 960x544. That is LTX-2.5's stage-1 size, but a two-stage request carries the output resolution and `LTX2HalveResolutionStage` rejects anything not divisible by 64, so the warmup request fails:

```
[Diffusion BCG] enabled by default for LTX2TwoStagePipeline
[Diffusion BCG] --warmup-resolutions unset; capturing the model default 960x544.
ValueError: LTX-2 two-stage requires resolution divisible by 64, got (544x960).
Server warmup failed; aborting startup
```

The non-BCG server warmup path already aligns to 64 through `_resolve_representative_warmup_resolution`; only the BCG branch of `_resolve_default_warmup_resolution` returns the sampling default as is.

## Modifications

`warmup_request_builder.py`: add `_two_stage_request_resolution` and use it where `_resolve_default_warmup_resolution` returns the sampling default as is. For `LTX2TwoStage*` pipelines, a default the halving rejects is treated as the stage-1 size and mapped to twice its size (960x544 -> 1920x1088).

Unchanged:
- explicit `--warmup-resolutions`
- one-stage pipelines
- defaults that already pass the alignment check (LTX-2 768x512, LTX-2.3 HQ 1920x1088)
- a default that doubling cannot fix (for example an explicit `--warmup-sampling-params` override) is left as written and still fails loudly

That early return also serves warmup that is not server-based, so that path gets the same mapping.

Tests: one new case in `test_cfg_parallel_warmup.py` for the default resolution of each pipeline above, and one extra assertion in `test_server_args.py::TestBreakableCudaGraphDefault::test_ltx25_distilled_two_stage_serving_turns_bcg_on` that the auto-enabled path ends up with `warmup_resolutions == ["1920x1088"]`.

## Accuracy Tests

No change to model outputs: only the shape the BCG warmup captures at startup changes.

Unit tests (1xH200 devbox, this commit on top of main 9691e711cd0; `test_cfg_parallel_warmup.py` + `test_server_args.py`):
- with `warmup_request_builder.py` reverted to main: the two new assertions fail (5 failed)
- with this change: 292 passed
- the 3 remaining failures are identical on main and here. Without an HF token `test_cfg_parallel_warmup.py` cannot be collected (importing `gpu_cases` resolves every case's gated model info), so I stubbed `gpu_cases` with empty lists, which breaks 2 tests that index it; the third asserts no warnings and trips on a diffusers Flax deprecation warning in that image. I did not run them with a token.

End to end with the reported command, default flags (`sglang serve --model-path Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers --num-gpus 2 --model-type diffusion --warmup-mode server --pipeline-class-name LTX2TwoStagePipeline --dit-layerwise-offload false --performance-mode speed --enable-torch-compile false --ulysses-degree 2`), then one `POST /v1/videos` at 1920x1088, 121 frames, 8 steps, seed 42:

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| 2xH200 | `ValueError ... got (544x960)`, `Server warmup failed; aborting startup` | BCG captures 1920x1088, request completes, ffprobe 1920x1088 / 121 frames |
| 1xH200 (same command without `--ulysses-degree`) | same failure | request completes, ffprobe 1920x1088 / 121 frames |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not a performance change. Each server served a single request, so the latencies from those runs (9.3 s on 2xH200, 15.4 s on 1xH200) are not benchmark numbers.

Not verified: a request that omits width/height would use the same 960x544 sampling default and, reading the code, would hit the same halving check on this pipeline. I did not run it and did not change request-side defaults here.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -138,7 +138,7 @@ def _resolve_default_warmup_resolution(
             or server_args.enable_breakable_cuda_graph is True
         )
     ):
-        return width, height
+        return _two_stage_request_resolution(server_args, width, height)
 
     if server_based_warmup:
         return _resolve_representative_warmup_resolution(server_args, sampling_defaults)
@@ -234,6 +234,24 @@ def _warmup_resolution_alignment(server_args: ServerArgs) -> int:
     return alignment
 
 
+def _two_stage_request_resolution(
+    server_args: ServerArgs, width: int, height: int
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Return the request resolution a sampling default maps to.
+
+    LTX-2 two-stage requests carry the output resolution and stage 1 runs at
+    half of it, so a default the halving rejects (LTX-2.5's 960x544) is the
+    stage-1 size and its request is twice that (1920x1088).
+    """
+    if not is_ltx2_two_stage_pipeline_name(server_args.pipeline_class_name):
+        return width, height
+    alignment = _warmup_resolution_alignment(server_args)
+    if _is_resolution_aligned((width, height), alignment):
+        return width, height
+    doubled = (width * 2, height * 2)
+    return doubled if _is_resolution_aligned(doubled, alignment) else (width, height)
+
+
 def _select_supported_warmup_resolution(
     supported_resolutions: list[tuple[int, int]] | None,
     target_area: int,

@@ -34,6 +34,10 @@
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.pipeline_configs.ltx_2_5 import LTX25PipelineConfig
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.pipeline_configs.sana_wm import SanaWMPipelineConfig
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.sample.longlive2 import LongLive2SamplingParams
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.sample.ltx_2 import (
+    LTX2SamplingParams,
+    LTX23HQSamplingParams,
+)
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.sample.ltx_2_5 import LTX25SamplingParams
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.sample.minimax_h3 import MiniMaxH3SamplingParams
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.sample.sampling_params import (
@@ -854,6 +858,35 @@ def test_bcg_capture_keeps_the_full_default_video_resolution(self):
             (1280, 720),
         )
 
+    def test_bcg_default_resolution_of_two_stage_is_the_output_resolution(self):
+        def resolve(pipeline_class_name, sampling_defaults):
+            server_args = SimpleNamespace(
+                pipeline_config=LTX25PipelineConfig(),
+                pipeline_class_name=pipeline_class_name,
+                enable_breakable_cuda_graph=True,
+            )
+            return _resolve_default_warmup_resolution(
+                server_args, sampling_defaults, server_based_warmup=True
+            )
+
+        # 960x544 is LTX-2.5's stage-1 size; the halving stage rejects it as a request
+        self.assertEqual(
+            resolve("LTX2TwoStagePipeline", LTX25SamplingParams()), (1920, 1088)
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            resolve("LTX2TwoStagePipeline", LTX2SamplingParams()), (768, 512)
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            resolve("LTX2TwoStageHQPipeline", LTX23HQSamplingParams()), (1920, 1088)
+        )
+        # doubling cannot fix this one, so the request stays as written
+        self.assertEqual(
+            resolve("LTX2TwoStagePipeline", SamplingParams(width=1000, height=600)),
+            (1000, 600),
+        )
+        # one-stage runs the default resolution as is
+        self.assertEqual(resolve("LTX2Pipeline", LTX25SamplingParams()), (960, 544))
+
     def test_ltx2_two_stage_warmup_uses_pipeline_alignment(self):
         server_args = MagicMock()
         server_args.warmup_steps = 1
